Google Cloud open-sourced TPU Sync - a C++ library that moves key-value (KV) cache blocks and model weights between Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) memory, host DRAM, shared storage, and the data center network.
 
🔗 More details on InfoQ 👉 https://www.infoq.com/news/2026/11/google-tpu-sync/
